stewardship.deescalation: Not applicable to antibiotics. Continue supportive/analgesic management; refer for rheumatology input if arthralgia persists beyond the expected post-viral window.
framework: Chikungunya is viral — antibiotics provide no benefit and should not be given.

Avoid early NSAID use if dengue cannot yet be excluded (bleeding risk); paracetamol is preferred until dengue is ruled out, since the two can be clinically difficult to distinguish in the first days of illness.
Counsel the patient that arthralgia can persist for weeks to months (chronic chikungunya arthropathy) — this is an expected disease course, not a sign of ongoing infection requiring antibiotics.
